relationship.statement: For small swings, a pendulum's period depends only on its length and gravity, not on the bob's mass or release angle. Longer strings swing slower, while stronger gravity makes the swing faster.
assumptions: The release angle stays small (under 15 deg) so the small-angle approximation holds.
The string is massless and rigid, and the pivot is frictionless.
Air drag is ignored, so the swing keeps a constant amplitude.

quantities.label: Length
quantities.meaning: Distance from the pivot to the center of the pendulum bob.

quantities.label: Gravity
quantities.meaning: Downward gravitational acceleration acting on the bob.

quantities.label: Bob mass
quantities.meaning: Mass of the pendulum bob; cancels out of the swing rate.

quantities.label: Release angle
quantities.meaning: Initial angle from vertical where the bob is released.

quantities.label: Period
quantities.meaning: Time for one full back-and-forth swing.

quantities.label: Frequency
quantities.meaning: Number of full swings completed per second.

quantities.label: Angle
quantities.meaning: Instantaneous angle from vertical during the swing.

quantities.label: Max speed
quantities.meaning: Peak speed of the bob at the bottom of the swing.

math.code: function compute(inputs, t) { var L = 1.0; var g = inputs.gravity; var m = inputs.mass; var a0 = inputs.angle0; var a0Rad = a0 * Math.PI / 180; var omega = Math.sqrt(g / L); var period = 2 * Math.PI / omega; var frequency = 1 / period; var theta = a0Rad * Math.cos(omega * t); var angle = theta * 180 / Math.PI; var maxSpeed = L * a0Rad * omega; var bobX = L * Math.sin(theta); var bobY = -L * Math.cos(theta); var bobSize = 0.25 + 0.65 * ((m - 0.5) / 4.5); var weightTipY = bobY - (0.06 + 0.002 * m * g); return { period: period, frequency: frequency, angle: angle, maxSpeed: maxSpeed, bobX: bobX, bobY: bobY, bobSize: bobSize, weightTipY: weightTipY, highGravity: g > 12, lowGravity: g < 6, heavyBob: m >= 3, wideRelease: a0 >= 13 }; }

outputs.meaning: Current angle of the string from vertical.
Maximum speed reached at the lowest point.
Horizontal position of the bob center.
Vertical position of the bob center.

cases.text: Heavy bob: period stays the same.

explanation.otherwise: Period depends only on L and g.

lesson.title: What changes a pendulum swing?
lesson.description: Watch a 1 m pendulum swing while you vary gravity, bob mass, and release angle. Track the angle over time to see what changes the period and what leaves it unchanged.
lesson.instructions: Use the sliders to change gravity, bob mass, and release angle. Watch the swing, the weight arrow, and the angle graph as time plays, or pause and scrub the timeline.
lesson.goal: For small swings of a fixed-length pendulum, only gravity changes the period; bob mass and release angle change weight or speed, not the swing time.
